groups.canonical_name: EV battery critical mineral supply constraints
groups.definition: Shortages or high costs of lithium, nickel, cobalt and rare earth metals could raise EV production costs and impede the company's EV strategy.

groups.canonical_name: EV strategy execution and battery costs
groups.definition: Failure to reduce battery cell and pack costs and execute the EV strategy could lead to losses, including write-downs on EV-related inventory.
